proof_attempt_summary: D0 proved the sharp bounded-completion interval, complete-graph swap and LP-parity formulas, a tight sparse-cycle relaxation gap, the bit-preserving arc-subdivision equivalence, and the design-based coverage and rational-threshold representation results. The field-tier case collapsed because the package did not resolve arbitrary binary-rational endpoint complexity or efficient full weak-null inversion; the Exact-Matching reduction direction no longer supplies a hardness boundary after Du2026. Three final certification issues were repaired on D0 main and a fresh independent audit found the banked artifact mathematically and source-faithfully sound.
tldr: When treatment labels and realized outcomes reside in files joined only through a candidate graph and a Hamming budget around a nominal bijection, what is the exact finite-population ATE compatibility set, and when can its endpoints and heterogeneous-effect randomization conclusions be computed? The proposal seeks a sharp interval theorem reducing identification to two signed matching scores, exact dense-graph swap and LP-parity laws, a tight sparse relaxation gap, and a bit-preserving rank-one arc-subdivision equivalence for the finite-encoded graphic frozen 2S-RecovAP specialization already situated in the Fischer--Hartmann--Lendl--Woeginger framework. It records the inherited \(RNC^2\) regime for polynomially bounded integer costs or rational costs admissibly scaled to such integers and a finite-penalty Exact-Matching reduction adaptation, while leaving arbitrary binary-rational endpoint complexity unresolved by this note and its source-verified comparators. It then gives uniformly design-valid confidence conclusions and an exact rational-threshold MILP representation for finite-support weak-null evaluation over bounded real-valued completions without claiming polynomial-time evaluation or full inversion.
gap: Existing causal record-linkage work mainly uses Bayesian, imputation, weighting, or mixture-model uncertainty, while candidate-graph partial identification already exists in an essay-level treatment. The unresolved opportunity is the combined finite-population counterfactual sharpness, graph-plus-Hamming endpoint structure, an encoding-sensitive boundary stated for a precise allowed-arc comparator, and design-valid inference under arbitrary effect heterogeneity. Exact binary-outcome inversion under complete randomization is now substantially developed, but continuous completion jointly with linkage ambiguity is not.
